title: BitPuter
summary: Programmer's calculator: HEX/DEC/BIN, bit grid, floats, Unix time, CRCs
description:
BitPuter is a keyboard-first programmer's calculator for the CardputerZero.

- 8/16/32/64-bit words, unsigned or signed; every operation wraps like a register
- One value in HEX, DEC, OCT and an editable bit grid (flip, set, invert bits), popcount and MSB
- C operators | ^ & << >> >>> ~ ** with C precedence; input in DEC, HEX, BIN or OCT
- Literals 0xFF 0b101 'RIFF' 4K f32(1.5); variables, ans and history
- popcnt clz ctz bswap rev rol ror mask field set/clr/tgl sext align isqrt log2 and more
- The same bits as ASCII, IEEE-754 float/double or Unix time
- Byte orders side by side: ABCD / DCBA / BADC / CDAB with decimal and float (Modbus word swap)
- CRC page: CRC-16/MODBUS, CRC-32, CRC-32C, CCITT, XMODEM, KERMIT, ARC, CRC-8, 1-Wire, Sensirion, NMEA XOR, SUM8 with wire byte order

Tab switches BITS / CRC, F1 shows help.
